name: Key
overview: The Bible presents keys as powerful symbols of authority and control, as seen in Isaiah 22:22 and Revelation 3:7 where the key of David signifies sovereign power to open and shut with divine authority. In Matthew 16:19, Jesus grants the keys of the kingdom of heaven to Peter, emphasizing the binding and loosing authority given to His church. Keys also represent access to knowledge and spiritual truth, yet Luke 11:52 warns against those who hinder others from entering by removing the key of knowledge. Additionally, keys symbolize Christ's victory over death and hell, as declared in Revelation 1:18, affirming His eternal dominion. The narrative in Judges 3:25 illustrates the practical use of keys, reinforcing their role as instruments of control and access.
